import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    # Extract source dataframe
    df = inputs["meter_reads"].copy()
    
    # Step 1: Sort by meter_id ASC, read_ts ASC, read_seq ASC
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["meter_id", "read_ts", "read_seq"],
        ascending=[True, True, True],
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Step 2: Dedup - keep LAST row per meter_id
    # Reset index to allow proper deduplication
    df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
    # Keep the last occurrence of each meter_id
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["meter_id"], keep="last")
    
    # Step 3: Aggregate by zone
    # Group by zone (including NULL as a real group) and aggregate
    grouped = df.groupby("zone", dropna=False).agg({
        "kwh": "sum",
        "meter_id": "count"
    }).reset_index()
    
    # Rename columns to match output schema
    grouped.columns = ["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]
    
    # Step 4: Prepare output
    result = grouped[["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]]
    
    return {"zone_totals": result}
